title: Algebra for a monad
description: JSON Schema for a T-algebra of a monad T — a pair (A, α) where A is an object of C and α : T(A) → A is a structure morphism satisfying unit law (α ∘ η_A = id_A) and multiplication law (α ∘ μ_A = α ∘ T(α)) (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. VI §2). The category of all T-algebras is the Eilenberg-Moore category C^T.

monad.description: The monad T this is an algebra for.

carrier-object.description: The carrier object A of the algebra.

structure-morphism.description: The structure morphism α : T(A) → A. Satisfies the unit law and multiplication law; both are universally-quantified equations checked by separate transformers.
